Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening. response:
You're sitting on the couch, playing video games, when your 12-year-old sister Lily bursts into the room, a mischievous grin spreading across her face.

"Rai, I need your help!" she exclaims, plopping down beside you on the couch. "I'm going to be babysitting for Grandma tonight, and I want to make sure I'm ready. But I need your help to practice."

You look up at her, skeptical. "What do you need me to do?"

Lily's grin widens. "I want you to help me train in babysitting. But I have a special plan. I want to regress you back to being a 6-year-old so I can babysit you for the evening."

You raise an eyebrow. "What? No way. That's not going to happen."

Lily shrugs. "Oh, come on. It'll be fun, I promise. We can play games and have a sleepover. You'll be so much easier to take care of when you're little."

You shake your head, but Lily's enthusiasm is starting to get to you. You're not sure what to do.

    "What's the point of regressing me back to being a 6-year-old, anyway?" you ask, trying to stall for time.

Lily thinks for a moment before responding. "Well, it's just that when you're little, you'll be so much more fun to play with. And I'll be able to teach you all sorts of cool babysitting skills. Plus, it'll be good practice for when I'm older and I need to take care of my own kids."

You're not convinced, but Lily's persistence is starting to wear you down. You're not sure what to do, but you're willing to listen to her idea a little longer.

    "Okay, fine," you say finally. "But if this is some kind of trick, I'm blaming you."

Lily squeals with excitement and throws her arms around you. "Yay! I knew you'd see it my way!"

As she hugs you, you start to feel a strange sensation wash over you. It's like your body is being pulled apart and put back together again, and you feel yourself shrinking down to a tiny 6-year-old version of yourself.

You look down and see that you're now wearing a pair of tiny shorts and a t-shirt, and your legs are shorter and your feet are smaller. You're not sure what's happening, but you're starting to feel a little scared.

    "Whoa, what's going on?" you ask, trying to sound brave.

Lily just laughs and pulls you up to your feet. "You're a 6-year-old now, Rai! Let's go have some fun!"

What do you do?
